1) Pilot setup (owner: Nikhil) — Day 0-3: access for 3 users, sample data ingestion (redacted), monitoring dashboard shared
2) Tech eval (owner: Grace) — Day 4-14: performance & quality checks, sample prompts, routing and caching baseline
